name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Enterprise-grade Agent Skill Marketplace for auditing website AI Discoverability (indexing, understanding, citation) and On-Site Referral Engagement.
author: Adobe University Hackathon 2026 Submission

skills.description: Coordinates full-site audit across all domain skills, enforces robots.txt polite crawling, deduplicates findings, applies deterministic severity scoring, and emits the final JSON audit report with proactive recommendations.
Audits AI crawler accessibility, robots.txt directives for AI user-agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.), X-Robots-Tag headers, sitemaps, and llms.txt adoption.
Audits client-side JS hydration gaps (raw HTML vs DOM text), facts trapped in non-text media (missing alt text, canvas, video/audio transcripts), and semantic HTML hierarchy.

Audits Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, entity disambiguation via sameAs links (Wikidata, Wikipedia, Crunchbase), quotable definition sentences, and Appendix E personalization signals (areaServed, hreflang).
Audits temporal integrity (timestamps, copyright staleness), Appendix D cross-web corroboration (NAP consistency, multi-source agreement), and Appendix F summarization information density.

Audits on-site landing experience for AI-referred visitors, heading ID anchor links (#section-id), above-the-fold value clarity (3-second rule), popup/interstitial bounce risks, and cognitive load (Flesch-Kincaid).
